title: AgentPrimordia Go API Contract
description: Defines the output format of the Go public API extractor for AgentPrimordia. Each module corresponds to a Go source file under pkg/, containing exported types, functions, constants, and variables with optional stability annotations.

version.description: The version string of the AgentPrimordia framework (e.g. '3.1.0'), matching the source code.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the API contract was generated, e.g. '2026-07-31T11:01:11Z'.

modules.description: List of Go source modules (one entry per file under pkg/) that contain exported API symbols.

Module.description: Represents a single Go source file and all of its exported symbols.

name.description: Logical module name derived from the Go file (e.g. 'a2a', 'agent', 'chaos', 'memory').

file.description: Relative path to the Go source file (e.g. 'agentprimordia/pkg/agent.go').

stability.description: Default stability level for this module. Present only when the file has a file-level Stability annotation.

types.description: Exported type definitions (interfaces, structs, type aliases) in this file.

functions.description: Exported top-level functions and standalone func declarations in this file.

constants.description: Exported constants (individual or grouped via const blocks) in this file.

variables.description: Exported package-level variables (including var-assigned functions) in this file.

Stability.description: API stability level following the AgentPrimordia four-tier stability policy.

TypeKind.description: Classification of the Go type definition.

TypeDef.description: An exported Go type definition. kind='alias' covers type aliases (e.g. 'type Agent = agent.Agent').

kind.description: Whether this type is an interface, struct, or type alias.

stability.description: Stability level of this individual type. Only present when the type has an explicit Stability annotation that differs from or supplements the module default.

doc.description: Godoc comment text for this type.

fields.description: Struct fields. Only present when kind='struct' and the struct has exported fields. Each entry is an object with 'name' and 'type'.

methods.description: Exported method names defined on or associated with this type. Only present when kind='struct' or kind='interface' and methods exist.

FieldDef.description: A single exported field within a Go struct definition.

type.description: Go type expression for this field (e.g. 'string', '*agent.CostTracker').

FuncDef.description: An exported top-level function declaration (not var-assigned; those appear in variables).

params.description: Ordered list of function parameter signatures as strings (e.g. ['agentID string', 'name string']). Absent when the function has no parameters.

returns.description: Ordered list of return type strings (e.g. ['bool'], ['*A2AAgentCard']). Absent when the function has no return values.

doc.description: Godoc comment text for this function.

value.description: String representation of the constant's right-hand side expression (e.g. 'agent.RoleSystem', '"3.1.0"').

doc.description: Inline godoc comment for this constant.

VarDef.description: An exported package-level variable definition (var-assigned functions, error sentinels, etc.).

doc.description: Godoc comment text for this variable.
